product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is an enterprise digital-experience analytics platform that captures customer interactions, identifies and quantifies friction, and helps teams and AI agents prioritize improvements.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes identifying where customers struggle, what it costs, and what to fix first.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes customizable enterprise plans and directs visitors to sales for quotes; it does not publish fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: Both appear as named Quantum Metric customer stories/case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Colorado Springs, Colorado as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile and company story identify 2015 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes at least two technical posts on product architecture and data/query behavior, authored by Skyler Bailey, identified as a Senior Solutions Engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public FAQ contains numerous product/analytics Q&As across categories and pages, with additional product resources; it functions as public product help material.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current listings include account-executive, solutions-engineering, and industry-leadership roles, but no AI, ML, data-science, or other specified AI/ML role titles.

model_provider.value: Google LLC (the subprocessors list says it provides in-platform AI features; no specific Google model is named).
model_provider.notes: Anthropic and OpenAI are also named in the list, but their stated support for in-platform AI features is prospective; Google is explicitly listed as providing in-platform AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The page claims SOC 2 attestation, ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and GDPR compliance. GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification; HIPAA and PCI are described as customer compliance obligations the controls help support.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies the January 2021 Series B as the latest round; the dated announcement reports $200 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified round was announced in January 2021, outside the 18-month period beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current openings include Enterprise Account Executive and other Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced its Summer 2026 product launch on July 16, 2026, within the six-month window; the launch included Felix Agentic general availability and expanded product capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current company story lists the leadership team, but no verified start dates for listed executives or dated C-level/VP departures within the 12-month window were found; the January 2026 release mentions strategic alignment without specifying leadership moves.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are explicitly named on the company's integrations and platform pages. These are visible integration signals, not necessarily confirmation of Quantum Metric's internal sales/marketing stack.
